description: Pins the repo's PRIMARY worktree to its default branch: BLOCKS a `git checkout`/`git switch` that would move the primary checkout (never a `git worktree add` linked worktree) onto anything but the default branch. Complements worktree-only-writes, which blocks the Edit/Write but never sees the checkout itself, and — once on a feature branch — wrongly treats that as 'exactly where authoring belongs' regardless of WHICH worktree it is. PER-REPO opt-in: shares the worktree-only-writes.worktree_only knob (env RIG_WORKTREE_ONLY or rig.yaml agent_hooks.worktree_only:true); default OFF. Deny-by-default: no env-var/inline self-service bypass (removed, Alex tg#6554); a repo owner may wire agent_hooks.approval_cmd in rig.yaml for external approval, else the block stands. Every checkout/switch segment in a CHAINED command is gated (approving one never waves a later one through), so a single invocation can call approval_cmd more than once; an internal 10s AGGREGATE budget across the whole chain (see pin_primary_worktree._MAIN_LOOP_BUDGET_S) denies any segment left unchecked once that budget is spent, keeping total runtime comfortably under this descriptor's timeout_ms 12000 even with multiple gate-worthy segments — so a legitimate slow approval, or too many chained segments, is never killed into the on_error=open SILENT ALLOW. on_error=open: a git/parse failure fails open (allows). Alex tg#6462/tg#6477.
